status: PROVISIONAL — NOT the definitions of SIP Draft §11
warning: The brief requires K01–K23 to be computed exactly as defined in SIP_Draft_Vrmac_Living_Heritage.pdf §11. That document was not present in the repository and could not be read from the build environment, so no definition here can be attributed to it. The computation ENGINE is generic and reads this file: replace the 'definition', 'spec' and 'unit' of each KPI with the wording of §11 and every number the dashboard shows changes accordingly, with no code change. Until then every aggregate is stored and displayed with provisional_definition = true.
replace_instructions: For each key below: copy the §11 wording into 'definition', set 'unit', 'person_level', 'gender_disaggregated', adjust 'spec' to the event types/properties it names, and set 'provisional': false. Run 'make kpi' afterwards.

spec_reference.count_events: number of events of the given types in the period
spec_reference.count_distinct_actors: distinct actor pseudonyms of those events (person-level)
spec_reference.count_distinct_devices: distinct device pseudonyms, deduplicated once per dedup_days (K11 rule)
spec_reference.share_property_true: share of events whose properties.<property> is true
